name: NetPrime (Videasy)
user_description: The absolute best choice for multiple Audio Dubs (Hindi, Tamil, etc.) and Anime.
dev_description: Tier 2 Fallback. Strict IP-locked tokens. Must use React Native WebView 'Snatch and Kill' to execute JS locally.

name: VidSrc (Original)
user_description: Lightning fast load times with a massive library of HD movies and TV shows.
dev_description: Standard HTML DOM. No IP-locking. Perfect for 200ms Cloudflare Worker server-side scraping.

name: VSEmbed
user_description: Highly reliable backup server with excellent global speeds.
dev_description: Russian mirror wrapper of VidSrc. Bypasses a lot of standard rate-limiting. Fast server-side scrape.

name: Embed.su
user_description: Clean, ad-free video player with quick buffering.
dev_description: Very clean DOM structure. Easy to parse AES payloads on the server.

name: VidLink
user_description: Solid overall performance for both classic and new releases.
dev_description: JSON responses often require an API key handshake, but easily spoofed via Edge Worker.

name: VidFast
user_description: Next-generation video player optimized for fast seeking.
dev_description: Built on Next.js. M3U8 links can be extracted directly from HTML props server-side.

name: MoviesAPI
dev_description: Shares a codebase with VidSpark. Clean /movie/{id} routing.

name: VidCore
user_description: High-quality source, but may require a brief loading screen.
dev_description: Tier 2 Fallback. Uses a JS 'One moment please' gate that blocks server-side scraping. WebView execution required.

name: SuperEmbed
user_description: A massive aggregator that searches 5+ servers to find your movie as a last resort.
dev_description: High latency (takes 2-3s to aggregate upstream). Set watchParty to false as it can switch CDNs and cause seek desyncs.

name: 2Embed
user_description: Legacy backup server. May occasionally fail to load.
dev_description: Historically reliable but recently prone to Cloudflare 522 errors. Marked as unstable.
